description:
Evaluate the posterior maxilla for implant placement suitability by measuring the subantral bone height (distance from alveolar crest to maxillary sinus floor) at tooth positions #3 and #14.

1. Navigate to the posterior maxilla in the cross-sectional views.
2. Identify the available bone height at position #3 (Upper Right 2nd Molar) and position #14 (Upper Left 2nd Molar).
3. Use the linear measurement tool to measure the vertical distance from the crest of the ridge to the floor of the sinus at both sites.
4. Create a clinical report text file at 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\sinus_evaluation_report.txt'.
5. The report must contain:
   - The measured bone height in mm for Position #3.
   - The measured bone height in mm for Position #14.
   - A clinical determination for each site: 'Standard placement' (if height >= 10mm) or 'Sinus lift required' (if height < 10mm).

Start with the pre-loaded patient case. Ensure measurements are precise.
